title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
description: Explore Davidson College without spending a dime. From lakeside relaxation to contemporary art galleries and serene nature trails, these campus spots offer free social and recreational opportunities for students and visitors alike.

cards.title: Contemporary Art at the VAC
cards.subtitle: Belk Visual Arts Center
cards.notes: Browse rotating contemporary exhibitions and the permanent collection. Admission is free for all visitors during standard gallery hours.
cards.short_summary: Free contemporary art galleries located within the Belk Visual Arts Center.
cards.evidence_claim: All programs of the Van Every/Smith Galleries are free and open to the public. Hours are M-F 10-5 and weekends 12-4.
cards.access_notes: Open Monday-Friday 10 a.m. to 5 p.m. (Wednesday until 7 p.m.) and weekends 12 p.m. to 4 p.m.

cards.title: Waterfront Relaxation
cards.subtitle: Lake Norman
cards.notes: Access 110 acres of waterfront property for swimming, sunbathing, and beach volleyball. Bring your CatCard for entry to this private college facility.
cards.short_summary: A 110-acre private recreational facility on Lake Norman for the Davidson community.
cards.evidence_claim: Lake Campus provides Davidson students with the unique opportunity to be involved in a variety of water activities including a waterfront beach and swim area.
cards.access_notes: Open 7 a.m. to 7 p.m. daily. Requires a valid College ID or Alumni Pass for entry.

cards.title: Hike the Nature Trails
cards.subtitle: Adjacent to Main Campus
cards.notes: Walk or jog through 200 acres of protected forest. The preserve features 5K and 8K trail loops accessible from the north and south campus entrances.
cards.short_summary: A 200-acre forested preserve with extensive trails for hiking, running, and bird watching.
cards.evidence_claim: The preserve offers 5K and 8K trails for jogging, walking, and bird watching, as well as large tracts of habitat for ecological studies.
cards.access_notes: Publicly accessible trails; open dawn to dusk daily.

cards.title: Self-Guided Art Walk
cards.subtitle: Across Campus
cards.notes: Tour over 20 major outdoor sculptures by world-renowned artists. Use the Bloomberg Connects app for free audio commentary at each stop.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor collection of world-class sculptures integrated into the college landscape.
cards.evidence_claim: The Campus Sculpture Program... exposes the Davidson community to a diverse range of sculptural works... interpreted through our digital guide on Bloomberg Connects.
cards.source_title: Art on Campus - Davidson College Art Galleries
cards.access_notes: Outdoor sculptures are accessible 24/7; the digital guide is free to download.

cards.title: Billiards at the Union
cards.subtitle: Alvarez College Union
cards.notes: Challenge friends to a game of pool on the main floor of the student union. This social hub is a staple for casual student hangouts.
cards.short_summary: A student-focused game room featuring pool tables inside the Alvarez College Union.
cards.evidence_claim: The college union staple pool tables are located on the main floor. The game room is named in memory of Thad Jones '63.
cards.access_notes: Open during regular student union hours; typically accessible until midnight or 1 a.m.

cards.title: Meditative Labyrinth Walk
cards.subtitle: Hobart Park
cards.notes: Find peace at this red-brick labyrinth tucked under the trees. It is lit at night, making it a quiet spot for reflection at any hour.
cards.short_summary: A peaceful outdoor brick labyrinth and garden designed for walking meditation.
cards.evidence_claim: The red-brick labyrinth and peace garden provide a great outdoor spot for walking meditation... The labyrinth is lit at night, making it accessible any time.
cards.access_notes: Located between Faculty Drive and Baker Drive; accessible 24/7 and lit at night.

cards.title: Cheer on the Wildcats
cards.subtitle: Various Campus Venues
cards.notes: Attend home games for sports like baseball, tennis, and volleyball for free. Most regular-season events are open to the public without a ticket.
cards.short_summary: Free admission to many NCAA Division I home games for the Davidson community and public.
cards.evidence_claim: All other sports' regular season, home games are free to the public with general admission seating.
cards.source_title: Student Ticket Home - Davidson College Athletics
cards.access_notes: Check the official athletics calendar for game times; no ticket required for non-revenue sports.

cards.title: Quiet Rest at Lingle Chapel
cards.subtitle: Main St. & Concord Rd.
cards.notes: Visit this serene worship space for prayer or quiet meditation. It remains open to the public 24/7, offering a peaceful retreat from campus life.
cards.short_summary: A historic chapel open 24/7 for public prayer, meditation, and quiet reflection.
cards.evidence_claim: Lingle Chapel is open to the public 24/7 for prayer, meditation, and quiet rest.
cards.access_notes: Open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week to the general public.

cards.title: Collaborative Study Space
cards.subtitle: E. Craig Wall Jr. Academic Center
cards.notes: Gather in the open forum or student common areas for group projects or casual conversation. This modern facility is designed for campus-wide collaboration.
cards.short_summary: A central gathering and study space featuring an open forum for the campus community.
cards.evidence_claim: Student common areas and an open forum space provide a gathering place for the campus community and encourages collaboration.
cards.access_notes: Open during academic building hours; typically accessible to students late into the evening.

cards.title: Classical Radio Hub
cards.subtitle: 423 North Main Street
cards.notes: Visit the home of WDAV 89.9, one of the nation's top classical public radio stations. The building is a unique campus resource for cultural arts programming.
cards.short_summary: The purpose-built facility for Davidson's award-winning classical public radio station.
cards.evidence_claim: The Newell Building is home to WDAV 89.9, a public radio service of Davidson College... providing classical music and cultural arts programming.
cards.access_notes: Public areas are accessible during business hours; check for special events or open house tours.
